King's College London

Research environment

Our research culture and world-class research support services

By providing the best environment, support and networks for our community, from postgraduate research students to senior academics, King's College London enables the delivery of research excellence. We are committed to advancing a positive research culture which focuses not just on research outcomes but on how we conduct our research – within an inclusive environment in which all staff can prosper. Discover research support services at every step of our researchers' careers from student to professor, and at every stage of their research project lifecycle, from application development to commercialisation. And discover how we support our research community to thrive, through our core values of fairness, inclusivity, collegiality, respect and appreciation.

Find out more about King’s research culture
